company.description: Zeekeez is the 1st UAE’s Property Portal for Individuals and professionals. Thousands of properties for sale and for rent in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and in the UAE. Zeekeez is a property website in the UAE connecting buyers, sellers, tenants, agents and developers built by expats who are tired by basic portals, lack of transparency and hidden properties. We are not just another portal, we decided to help millions of residents who live in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and in the UAE by providing unprecedented user experience, innovative features and the strongest technology.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,650,000 to $1,650,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 52 (-17).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
